text.name: Warlord's Banner of Health
text.description:
{Warlord's Banner of Health}

Increases stack's Health by 2 and additionally doubles the stack's current Health bonus in combat.
text.event: You pick up the Warlord's Banner of Health.

text.name: Warlord's Banner of Attack
text.description:
{Warlord's Banner of Attack}

Increases stack's Attack by 2 and additionally doubles the stack's current Attack bonus in combat.
text.event: You pick up the Warlord's Banner of Attack.

text.name: Warlord's Banner of Defence
text.description:
{Warlord's Banner of Defence}

Increases stack's Defense by 2 and additionally doubles the stack's current Defense bonus in combat.
text.event: You pick up the Warlord's Banner of Defence.

text.name: Warlord's Banner of Damage
text.description:
{Warlord's Banner of Damage}

Increases stack's Damage by 1 and additionally doubles the stack's current Damage bonus in combat.
text.event: You pick up the Warlord's Banner of Damage.

text.name: Warlord's Banner of Speed
text.description:
{Warlord's Banner of Speed}

Increases stack's Speed by 1 and additionally doubles the stack's current Speed bonus in combat.
text.event: You pick up the Warlord's Banner of Speed.

text.name: Warlord's Banner of Experience
text.description:
{Warlord's Banner of Experience}

Increases the experience this stack gains from battle by 50%.
text.event: You pick up the Warlord's Banner of Experience.

text.name: Warlord's Banner of Piercing
text.description:
{Warlord's Banner of Piercing}

Reduces the Defense of the attacked enemy stack by 25%.
text.event: You pick up the Warlord's Banner of Piercing.

text.name: Warlord's Banner of Protection
text.description:
{Warlord's Banner of Protection}

Reduces all damage this stack receives by 25%.
text.event: You pick up the Warlord's Banner of Protection.

text.name: Warlord's Banner of Retaliation
text.description:
{Warlord's Banner of Retaliation}

Allows this stack to retaliate two additional times per round.
text.event: You pick up the Warlord's Banner of Retaliation.
